paragraphs: Clinical Project Management connects the people and activities responsible for study delivery, from planning and startup through study closeout. It supports a shared view of responsibilities, progress and the work ahead.

capabilities.title: Clinical Operations
capabilities.summary: Support study planning, site delivery, monitoring and closeout.
paragraphs: Our Clinical Operations team provides comprehensive support throughout the planning, execution, management, and closeout of clinical studies across all phases of development. We partner with sponsors, CROs, and investigative sites to ensure efficient study delivery, regulatory compliance, patient safety, and high-quality data collection.

Our experienced clinical professionals work closely with sponsors and investigative sites to ensure protocol adherence, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and successful study execution. Through proactive communication, operational excellence, and a patient-centric approach, we help accelerate clinical development while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.
items: Clinical Trial Monitoring (On-site, Remote, and Hybrid)
Data Review and Query Resolution Support

capabilities.title: Clinical Data Management
capabilities.summary: Connect clinical data collection, review and database readiness.
paragraphs: Clinical Data Management supports the collection, review and organization of clinical study information. Connected workflows help teams follow data queries, maintain visibility into quality and prepare for downstream analysis.
items: Data review and query resolution support

capabilities.title: Biostatistics
capabilities.summary: Bring statistical expertise to the evidence each study needs to build.
paragraphs: Biostatistics brings a statistical perspective to clinical development, helping teams connect study objectives, analysis-ready data and the interpretation of study findings.

capabilities.title: Statistical Programming
capabilities.summary: Connect raw data, CDISC standards, analysis datasets and reporting.
paragraphs: Statistical Programming supports the path from raw clinical datasets to standardized SDTM, analysis-ready ADaM and final tables, listings and figures. TruMinds combines experienced programming teams with its proprietary TruForm automation platform.

capabilities.title: Regulatory Affairs
capabilities.summary: Keep regulatory documentation and submission work connected to the study.
paragraphs: Regulatory Affairs support connects clinical development with the documentation, coordination and review needed for regulatory submissions. It helps teams keep regulatory needs visible as a program moves through development.

capabilities.title: Pharmacovigilance & Drug Safety
capabilities.summary: Connect safety surveillance, risk management and lifecycle oversight.
paragraphs: Our Pharmacovigilance and Drug Safety team provides comprehensive safety surveillance, risk management, and regulatory compliance services throughout the entire product lifecycle—from early clinical development through post-marketing surveillance. We help sponsors proactively identify, evaluate, and mitigate safety risks while ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements and industry standards, including FDA, EMA, MHRA, ICH, and other international health authorities.

Our experienced safety professionals support the collection, assessment, processing, and reporting of safety information to ensure patient well-being and maintain the benefit-risk profile of investigational and marketed products. Through robust pharmacovigilance systems, advanced signal detection methodologies, and quality-driven processes, we help sponsors maintain regulatory compliance and safeguard patient safety.

Our team collaborates closely with sponsors, clinical operations teams, medical monitors, and regulatory affairs professionals to ensure timely safety reporting, effective risk management, and continuous compliance throughout the development and commercialization of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and combination products. By combining scientific expertise with operational excellence, we help organizations protect patients, meet regulatory expectations, and successfully advance their products to market.
items: Adverse Event (AE) and Serious Adverse Event (SAE) Processing
Safety Database Setup, Validation, and Management
Regulatory Safety Reporting to Global Health Authorities
Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs) and PBRERs
Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Reporting
Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Development and Maintenance
Safety Monitoring Committee and Data Monitoring Committee Support
Vendor Oversight and Pharmacovigilance Compliance Management
Post-Marketing Surveillance and Risk Minimization Activities

capabilities.title: Medical Affairs
capabilities.summary: Connect scientific evidence with healthcare professionals and stakeholders.
paragraphs: Medical Affairs serves as the critical bridge between clinical development, healthcare professionals, patients, and commercial teams. TruMinds Clinical provides strategic and operational Medical Affairs support to help organizations communicate scientific and clinical evidence, engage key stakeholders, and maximize the value of their products throughout the product lifecycle. Our experienced professionals support both pre-launch and post-launch activities, ensuring scientific integrity, regulatory compliance, and effective stakeholder engagement.
items: Field Medical / Medical Science Liaison (MSL) Support

capabilities.title: Quality Assurance & Compliance
capabilities.summary: Strengthen quality systems, risk oversight and inspection readiness.
paragraphs: Maintaining quality and regulatory compliance is essential to successful clinical development and commercialization. Our Quality Assurance (QA) and Compliance professionals help sponsors, CROs, and healthcare organizations establish, maintain, and continuously improve robust quality systems that support regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

We provide comprehensive quality oversight and compliance solutions designed to ensure adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and applicable global regulatory guidelines. Our experienced QA experts work proactively to identify risks, strengthen quality processes, and support inspection readiness throughout the product lifecycle.

Our quality professionals collaborate closely with clinical, regulatory, pharmacovigilance, and operational teams to promote a culture of quality and compliance. Through risk-based quality management, proactive oversight, and continuous process improvement, we help organizations minimize compliance risks, maintain regulatory readiness, and achieve successful clinical and regulatory outcomes.
items: Quality Management System (QMS) Design and Implementation
Root Cause Analysis and Risk Assessments
Deviation, Nonconformance, and Change Control Management
Quality Training Programs and Compliance Education
Inspection Mock Audits and Readiness Programs

capabilities.title: TruForm EDC
capabilities.imageAlt: Clinician reviewing information on a laptop with a patient
paragraphs: TruForm EDC is a next-generation Electronic Data Capture (EDC) platform designed to streamline clinical data collection, improve data quality, and accelerate study execution. Built on a secure, cloud-native architecture, TruForm EDC enables sponsors, CROs, and research sites to efficiently design studies, capture clinical data, manage queries, and monitor study progress in real time.

The platform combines intuitive study configuration, intelligent edit checks, automated workflows, and seamless integration with other clinical systems to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency. With configurable electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), role-based security, complete audit trails, and compliance with global regulatory standards including FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH-GCP, and GDPR, TruForm EDC provides a scalable solution for Phase I-IV clinical trials.

Whether managing a single-site study or a large multinational clinical program, TruForm EDC helps organizations reduce study startup timelines, improve data accuracy, minimize data queries, and accelerate database lock.
items: Intelligent edit checks and query management

capabilities.title: TruForm SDTM
capabilities.imageAlt: Doctor holding a tablet in a hospital corridor
paragraphs: TruForm SDTM transforms raw clinical trial data into standardized CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets using intelligent automation and metadata-driven processes. Designed to simplify one of the most time-consuming aspects of clinical programming, the platform significantly reduces manual mapping while ensuring consistency, traceability, and regulatory compliance.

Leveraging reusable standards, AI-assisted specifications, automated validations, and configurable transformation rules, TruForm SDTM enables sponsors to produce submission-ready datasets faster with improved quality and reduced programming effort.

The platform supports multiple source systems and provides complete traceability from raw clinical data through standardized datasets, helping organizations accelerate regulatory submissions while maintaining the highest standards of data integrity.

capabilities.title: TruForm ADaM
capabilities.imageAlt: Laboratory researcher seated beside a microscope
paragraphs: TruForm ADaM is an intelligent platform that automates the creation of CDISC Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets from SDTM data. The solution enables statistical programmers and biostatisticians to efficiently generate analysis-ready datasets while maintaining full traceability to source data and regulatory standards.

Using metadata-driven automation, reusable derivation libraries, and standardized programming frameworks, TruForm ADaM dramatically reduces development time while improving consistency across studies.

The platform supports complex derivations, analysis flags, population definitions, efficacy and safety analyses, and regulatory-compliant metadata, helping organizations accelerate statistical analyses and submission readiness.

capabilities.title: TruForm TLF
capabilities.imageAlt: Laboratory scientists examining samples and recording findings
paragraphs: TruForm TLF is an enterprise reporting platform that automates the generation of high-quality Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports, integrated summaries, and regulatory submissions.

By combining reusable templates, metadata-driven reporting, standardized statistical programming, and AI-assisted specifications, the platform minimizes repetitive programming while ensuring consistency and accuracy across studies.

TruForm TLF produces publication-quality outputs in multiple formats and integrates seamlessly with statistical analysis workflows, enabling organizations to reduce reporting timelines while maintaining compliance with regulatory expectations.
items: Clinical study reports and regulatory outputs

capabilities.title: TruForm DocuVault
capabilities.imageAlt: Healthcare professional holding a tablet and a medicine container
paragraphs: TruForm DocuVault is a comprehensive Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) and document management platform that centralizes all essential clinical trial documentation within a secure, validated cloud environment.

The platform enables sponsors and CROs to efficiently create, organize, review, approve, version, archive, and retrieve study documents throughout the entire clinical trial lifecycle. Intelligent workflows, configurable document classifications, electronic signatures, inspection-ready filing structures, and automated completeness checks help ensure continuous TMF quality and regulatory compliance.
Designed to support remote collaboration across global teams, TruForm DocuVault provides complete visibility into document status while simplifying regulatory inspections and audits.
items: Document review, approval and version control

capabilities.title: TruForm eConsent
capabilities.imageAlt: Two clinicians reviewing a tablet together
paragraphs: TruForm eConsent modernizes the informed consent process by replacing paper-based consent forms with an interactive digital experience. Participants can review study information through videos, animations, graphics, and educational content before securely providing electronic consent from virtually anywhere.
The platform improves participant understanding, enhances engagement, simplifies re-consenting, and ensures complete version control throughout the study lifecycle.

Sponsors and research sites benefit from centralized consent tracking, automated notifications, electronic signatures, audit trails, multilingual support, and seamless integration with EDC and CTMS platforms.

capabilities.title: TruForm Adjudication
capabilities.imageAlt: Two doctors reviewing clinical records together
paragraphs: TruForm Adjudication provides a secure, centralized platform for independent clinical endpoint adjudication across global clinical trials.

The solution streamlines event submission, committee review, consensus management, and final adjudication through configurable workflows designed to maintain consistency, objectivity, and regulatory compliance.

Automated case routing, blinded review processes, electronic document management, configurable adjudication forms, and comprehensive audit trails enable organizations to reduce review timelines while improving endpoint quality and operational efficiency.
items: Blinded review and automated case routing

capabilities.title: TruForm RBQM
capabilities.imageAlt: Clinical team reviewing records at a workstation
paragraphs: TruForm RBQM is an intelligent Risk-Based Quality Management platform designed to proactively identify, monitor, and mitigate clinical trial risks using centralized monitoring, advanced analytics, and real-time operational intelligence.

The platform continuously evaluates Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), protocol deviations, enrollment trends, data quality metrics, and site performance to help study teams focus resources where they are needed most.

Supporting ICH E6(R3) quality management principles, TruForm RBQM enables organizations to reduce operational risk, improve patient safety, enhance data integrity, and optimize monitoring activities through data-driven decision making.
items: Key Risk Indicator and KPI review

capabilities.title: TruForm CTMS
capabilities.imageAlt: Doctor working at a desktop computer
paragraphs: TruForm CTMS is a comprehensive Clinical Trial Management System that provides complete operational oversight throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.

The platform enables sponsors and CROs to efficiently manage study planning, site activation, investigator management, subject enrollment, milestone tracking, budgets, contracts, payments, monitoring visits, and study performance from a single centralized environment.

Real-time dashboards, configurable workflows, automated notifications, and advanced reporting empower study teams to make informed decisions, improve collaboration, and deliver clinical trials on time and within budget.

capabilities.title: TruForm RTSM
capabilities.imageAlt: Healthcare professional reviewing medicine information with a tablet
paragraphs: TruForm RTSM delivers intelligent patient randomization and clinical supply management for modern global clinical trials.

The platform automates subject randomization, treatment assignment, investigational product inventory, depot management, shipment forecasting, and emergency unblinding while maintaining study integrity and treatment blinding.
Advanced forecasting algorithms help optimize drug supply, reduce waste, minimize stock shortages, and ensure continuous product availability across all participating clinical sites.

capabilities.title: TruForm ePRO
paragraphs: TruForm ePRO enables patients to securely report symptoms, treatment experiences, medication adherence, quality-of-life assessments, and other clinical outcomes using smartphones, tablets, or web-based applications.
Real-time patient data collection improves participant engagement, reduces missing data, eliminates manual transcription errors, and enhances the overall patient experience throughout the study.

The platform supports multilingual questionnaires, Bring Your Own Device (BYOD), scheduled reminders, offline data capture, wearable integrations, and seamless interoperability with EDC, CTMS, and other clinical systems, enabling sponsors to capture high-quality patient-centered data while improving study compliance and retention.
items: Symptoms, quality of life and treatment experience
BYOD, offline entry and scheduled reminders

paragraphs: TruMinds Clinical is a trusted Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing comprehensive clinical research solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies worldwide. We support Phase I through Phase IV clinical trials across a broad range of therapeutic areas, helping sponsors accelerate development timelines, maintain regulatory compliance, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster.

Our service delivery model combines scientific expertise, advanced technologies, operational excellence, and a client-centric approach to ensure successful execution of clinical programs from study startup through regulatory submission and post-marketing activities. Whether supporting a single study or an entire development portfolio, TruMinds delivers flexible, scalable, and cost-effective solutions tailored to each client's unique needs.

Our proprietary in-house automated platform, TRUFORM, is designed to transform raw clinical datasets into standardized SDTM datasets, convert SDTM to ADaM, and generate final TLFs efficiently and accurately. By integrating Artificial Intelligence and automation technologies into the clinical data lifecycle, TruMinds Clinical significantly reduces manual effort, improves data consistency, enhances productivity, and accelerates database lock to submission timelines. Our experienced team is committed to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, technical expertise, efficient execution, and a collaborative work culture to ensure smooth project flow and timely delivery of results.

overview.title: Connected information.
paragraphs: TruForm™ is TruMinds Clinical's next-generation, AI-powered Clinical Trial Technology Platform designed to transform the way clinical trials are planned, managed, executed, and submitted. Built to support pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device companies, CROs, and research organizations, TruForm provides a fully integrated suite of intelligent software solutions that seamlessly connect every phase of the clinical development lifecycle—from study startup and patient enrollment to database lock, statistical reporting, regulatory submissions, and study closeout.

Traditional clinical trials often rely on multiple disconnected systems, creating data silos, duplicate data entry, complex integrations, and operational inefficiencies. TruForm eliminates these challenges by bringing together clinical operations, patient engagement, clinical data management, statistical programming, quality management, document management, and regulatory processes into a single unified platform. This integrated approach provides a single source of truth, enabling study teams to collaborate more effectively, improve data quality, reduce operational complexity, and accelerate decision-making throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.

Designed with flexibility and scalability in mind, TruForm supports studies ranging from early Phase I research to large, global Phase III and Phase IV clinical trials. The platform leverages cloud-native architecture, artificial intelligence, intelligent automation, configurable workflows, reusable standards, and real-time analytics to simplify complex processes while ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements, including FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH-GCP, GDPR, HIPAA, and CDISC standards

overview.title: Flexible expertise.
paragraphs: Our clinical delivery models include Functional Service Provider (FSP) services and Hybrid engagement models that combine the flexibility of an FSP with the comprehensive capabilities of a CRO. This approach enables sponsors to scale resources efficiently, reduce operational costs, and maintain greater control over clinical programs while leveraging TruMinds Clinical’s therapeutic expertise, proven processes, technology solutions, and global delivery capabilities. Whether supporting a single function or an entire clinical development program, our flexible models are tailored to meet each client’s unique requirements.

Through our FSP+CRO delivery model, clients gain access to highly experienced professionals across Clinical Operations, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Medical Writing, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Quality Assurance, and Clinical Project Management. With a global team and a commitment to quality, compliance, and operational excellence, TruMinds Clinical helps sponsors accelerate development timelines, improve study execution, and achieve successful clinical outcomes across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and diagnostic programs.
